doc.title: campfire
doc.body: Sound effect only: A small wood campfire outdoors, steady soft flames with irregular close crackles and tiny pops. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: forge
doc.body: Sound effect only: A village blacksmith forge fire and gentle bellows, low warm embers and occasional subtle hot metal hiss. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: hammer
doc.body: Sound effect only: One dry iron hammer strike on a blacksmith anvil, sharp metallic attack and short natural ringing decay. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: sword
doc.body: Sound effect only: One fast steel sword swing through air, a clean short whoosh with a faint metallic edge. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: spell
doc.body: Sound effect only: One fantasy fire spell cast, rising ignition whoosh followed by rushing flame and crackling decay. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: wolf
doc.body: Sound effect only: A grey wolf gives a nasal bark, then a teeth-baring growl and a short mournful yowl. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.
